content:
Alice Chen: quick question — Compliance just asked for 3yr retention on auth & token logs. SIEM export size would triple. Thinking we need sampling + gated exports for external auditors. thoughts? :thinking_face:
Miguel Torres: ugh. 3y raw is rough. We should consider: tiered retention (raw short, indexed long), plus export-only snapshots for audits. sampling helps but can bite investigations. :eyes:
Priya Nair: agree with Miguel. For incident work we need full fidelity for ~90d. beyond that we can compress + keep metadata (user, ip, action). Can we redact PII and keep event vectors?
Tom Blake: auditor ask is specifically for authentication events and MFA changes. They want evidence of configuration changes and login attempts. They may request key unwraps for certain buckets. We need a workflow for exposing decrypted blobs.
Alice Chen: proposal: 90d full raw; 3y aggregated index for search (user, timestamp, outcome); 1yr cold raw encrypted with KMS wrap and JIT unwrap for approved auditor requests. Gate exports via a short-lived role and ticketing.
Miguel Torres: technically doable. Options for unwrap: (a) give auditors a read-only view with KMS-proxy that unwraps for queries only, (b) timeboxed key grants via HSM/JIT, or (c) deliver pre-scrubbed CSVs. I'm leaning toward KMS-proxy + RBAC.
Priya Nair: +1 KMS-proxy. Keeps keys within our control and we can log every unwrap. Need to ensure unwrap requests create immutable audit trails. Also need playbook for emergency forensic needs.
Alice Chen: draft RBAC change (short):
```
- group: security-auditors-readonly
- permissions: siem.search:read, s3:object:get:retention-raw, kms:decrypt:temporary
- constraint: ticket-id + approver + TTL=12h
```
Miguel Torres: add requirement: key-unwrap must require 2 approvers for external parties. internal pen testers can be single approver. Also rate-limit unwraps.
Tom Blake: auditors asked if they can run queries themselves. I'd prefer we run queries and hand them results; less blast radius. If we provide a query-runner UI we must log SQL and returned rows.
Priya Nair: for SIEM exports, we should introduce export gating: exports over X GB require sec-review and ticket. small ad-hoc exports can be automated. Also do sampling policy: every Nth raw event + prioritized retention for fails and admin ops.
Alice Chen: sounds good. Action items: Miguel to prototype KMS-proxy unwrap logs + rate limits; Priya to write export-gating policy doc & sampling rules; Tom to get auditor ask template and approval flow; I'll draft RBAC change request and JIRA.
Miguel Torres: starting prototype today. sharing quick config snippet for proxy headers: `X-Unwrap-Ticket: <ticket>` + `X-Unwrap-Approver: <user>` which we log.
Tom Blake: I'll paste auditor template in the ticket. Also adding: add legal sign-off for sharing decrypted artifacts.
Alice Chen: thanks team. looping in audit-bot to create an audit issue. :thumbsup:
audit-bot: created issue SEC-1482 with label "auditor-retention" and assigned to Alice Chen.
Priya Nair: pinging eng-oncall to note this might affect nightly indexing costs; will coordinate autoscale limits.
Alice Chen: thanks — will update once we have prototype and RBAC PR.
